Short_Description:
MELEE. Once per turn. 
When Targetted or selected to Fight (pick one): 
- +1 S melee
- +1 T [+1 S] [+1 T]
Long_Description:
Once per turn, per unit: In the Fight phase, when this unit is selected to fight or when an enemy unit targets this unit, you can select one of the following:
- This unit’s melee attacks have +1 S.
- This unit has +1 T.

Long_Description: While this model is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

Short_Description:
Shoot an enemy, then, in MELEE, 
ALL Tyranids have extra -1 AP [+1 AP]
Long_Description: In your Shooting phase, after this model has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the turn, each time a friendly Tyranids unit makes a melee attack that targets that enemy unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. The same enemy unit can only be affected by this ability once per turn.

Short_Description: Enemy SHOOTING: Lose a wound → Surge up to D6+2"
Long_Description: In your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot, if a model in this unit lost a wound as a result of those attacks, this unit can make a surge move of up to D6+2".

Short_Description: Advance and Charge. [ADVANCE AND CHARGE]
Long_Description: This unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

Short_Description: Termagant 6" RANGED have LETHAL HITS [LETHAL HITS]
Long_Description: While a friendly Termagants unit is within 6" of this model, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

Short_Description: Hit enemy loses Benefit of Cover this Shooting phase. [IGNORES COVER]
Long_Description: In your Shooting phase, after this unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, that enemy unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover.

Short_Description: If destroyed by - and if it has not fought, roll one D6: on a 4+, it can fight before it's removed.
Long_Description: If this model is destroyed by a melee attack, if it has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

Short_Description: At the end of enemy turn, if not within Engagement, remove from battlefield and place into Strategic Reserves. [STRATEGIC RESERVES]
Long_Description: At the end of your opponent’s turn, if this unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Short_Description: In Shooting, after shooting, select one enemy to take Battle-shock with -1.
Long_Description: In your Shooting phase, after this model has shot, select one unit hit by one or more of those attacks. That unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.

Short_Description: Overwatch on 5+ or 4+ if on objective. [OVERWATCH]
Long_Description: Each time you target this unit with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem, while resolving that Stratagem, hits are scored on unmodified Hit rolls of 5+, or unmodified Hit rolls of 4+ instead if this unit is within range of an objective marker.

Short_Description: 9" have Synapse
Long_Description: While a friendly Tyranids unit is within 9" of this model, that unit is within your army’s Synapse Range.

Short_Description: Enemy 6": -1 to Hit. If Below Half-strength, -1 to Wound. [ENEMY -1 TO HIT]
Long_Description: While an enemy unit is within 6" of this model, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll, and, if that enemy unit is Below Half-strength, subtract 1 from the Wound roll as well.

Short_Description:
While within 6", enemy is LD -1.

If below Starting strength, take battle-shock test enemy in Command Ph
Long_Description:
While an enemy unit is within 6" of this model, worsen the Leadership characteristic of models in that unit by 1.

In addition, in the Battle-shock step of your opponent’s Command phase, if such an enemy unit is below its Starting Strength, it must take a Battle-shock test.

Short_Description: When this model destroys a Character, you gain 1CP. [GAIN 1 CP]
Long_Description: Each time this model destroys an enemy Character model, you gain 1CP.

Short_Description:
Each Melee vs a unit below its Starting Strength, add +1 To Hit.

If target is also Below Half-strength, add +1 To Wound. [+1 TO HIT] [+1 TO WOUND]
Long_Description:
Each time this model makes a - attack that targets a unit that is below its Starting Strength, add 1 to the Hit roll. 

If that target is also Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

Short_Description: Enemy (not TITANIC) in Engagement trying to Fall Back: 3+ they Remain Stationary.
Long_Description: Each time an enemy unit (excluding TITANIC units) within Engagement Range of one or more units from your army with this ability is selected to Fall Back, you can roll one D6: on a 3+, that enemy unit must Remain Stationary instead.

Short_Description: Destroy a model, all take battle shock within 6"
Long_Description: Each time this model is selected to fight, after resolving its attacks, if one or more enemy units were destroyed by those attacks, each enemy unit within 6" of this model must take a Battle-shock test.

Short_Description: If led by CHARACTER, while alive, they grant 5+ FNP to character. [FNP 5+]

Long_Description: Once per battle round, you can target this unit with the Rapid Ingress or Heroic Intervention Stratagem for 0CP, and can do so even if you have already targeted a different unit with that Stratagem this turn.

Long_Description: At the end of your Movement phase, roll one D6 for each enemy unit within 6" of this model: on a 2-3, that unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 4-5, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 6, that unit suffers D6 mortal wounds.

Short_Description: Fight phase, select enemy within Engagement Range: -1 To Hit. [ENEMY -1 TO HIT]
Long_Description: At the start of the Fight phase, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of this model. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

Long_Description: If this model is your WARLORD, each time your opponent targets a unit from their army with a Stratagem, if that unit is within 12" of this model, increase the cost of that use of that Stratagem by 1CP.

Long_Description: While this unit is within Synapse Range of a friendly TYRANIDS unit (excluding NEUROGAUNT units), it has the SYNAPSE keyword.

Short_Description: In Command, select 2 units within 18", they will stay in synapse.
Long_Description: In your Command phase, you can select up to two friendly TYRANIDS units within 18" of this model’s unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, the selected units are always considered to be within Synapse Range of your army.

You can target this unit with the Heroic Intervention Stratagem, regardless of any other uses of that Stratagem this phase. If you do:
- That use is -1 CP.
- That use does not prevent any uses of that Stratagem on other units this phase.

Long_Description: If one or more models from your army with this ability are on the battlefield when you unleash the Shadow in the Warp, subtract 1 from the Battle-shock test each enemy unit on the battlefield must take as a result.

While an enemy unit is within 12" of this model, if that unit is Battle-shocked:

Long_Description: Once per turn, in your Shooting phase, when selected to shoot, one unit with this ability can use it instead of making any attacks with its ranged weapons. Short_Description: Move thru terrain
Long_Description: This model can move through terrain features, but cannot end a move within a wall, a floor, etc. This model can be set up or end a move on any floor level of RUINS, but if that level is not the ground floor, it can only do so if its base does not overhang the floor at that level.

Pick an objective; OC 15 & FNP 5+

Long_Description:
At the start of the first battle round, select one of the following:
- Select one enemy unit. Until the end of the battle, each time this model makes an attack that targets that unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
- Select one objective marker. Until the end of the battle, while this model is within range of that objective marker, it has the FNP 5+ ability and an Objective Control characteristic of 15.

Long_Description: In your opponent’s Movement phase, if an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of this unit, if this unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, this unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".

Short_Description: Command Phase: Termagaunts 6" generate D3+3
Long_Description: In your Command phase, you can select one friendly Termagants unit within 6" of this model and return up to D3+3 destroyed Termagant models to that unit. A Termagants unit cannot be selected for this ability more than once per phase.

Short_Description: Enemy 6" fails Battle-shock: D3 mortal wounds and this unit regains D3.
Long_Description: While an enemy unit is within 6" of this unit, if this unit contains a Neurothrope, each time that enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test, it suffers D3 mortal wounds and one model in this unit regains up to D3 lost wounds.
